questions.question: **In the following question, four words are given out of which one word is correctly spelt. Select the correctly spelt word.**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **intelligent**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Let's look at the meaning of the correct word. 

 
• **Intelligent**: Having or showing intelligence; especially of a higher degree. 
 
• **Example**: *Labradors are highly **intelligent** dogs.* 

Thus from the given points and example, it is clear that the correct answer is **intelligent**.

questions.question:

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'no improvement'.**

Many countries and States (is debating) a ban on plastic bags or taxing their use.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **are debating**. 

**__Key Points__**

Reading the above sentence we find that: 

 
• **Many countries and states** denote many individual countries and states, making it **plural**. 
 
• Therefore the **verb **in use should also be **plural**. 
 
• Hence we have to change **is debating **to **are debating**. 

Therefore the correct answer is **are debating**.

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech.**

He replied, “I cannot do so.”

options.text: He said he could not do so.
He replied that he could not do so.
He replied that he cannot did so.
He replied that he could never do so.

questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Here, direct speech is given. So, we convert it into indirect speech. The reporting verb "replied" is in simple past tense and modal verb **can **is used in inverted commas. So, it changes into simple past of **can, **i.e. **could. **Subject I changes into **he. **Rest of the sentence remains the same. Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

They selected the red car.

options.text: The red car is chosen by them.
The red car by them is selected.
The red car was selected by them.

questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

The tense used in active voice is simple past tense. So, while changing it into passive voice form, following pattern is used :-

Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject. 

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

From the perspective of positive psychology, mental (1)/ health may include an individual's ability to create a balance (2)/ between life activities and efforts to achieve psychology resilience. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Since, word** "psychology"** is a **noun **which is directly followed by another noun "resilience". So, replace it with adjective **psychological **to give a meaningful sentence.
 
• Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *From the perspective of positive psychology, mental health may include an individual's ability to create a balance between life activities and efforts to achieve **__psychological__ **resilience.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

The few crowd (1)/ was not surprising (2)/ considering the publicity involved. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Quantifier "the few" is used for countable noun. For e.g.:- There were the few mangoes on the table.

But, "crowd" is a uncountable noun. Hence, replace **the few **with **the little. **

So, part 1 has the grammatical error.
